text: The service SHALL accept payments only in INR, USD and EUR. Requests in any other currency SHALL be rejected with error code UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY.
rationale: SUPPORTED_CURRENCIES = {"INR","USD","EUR"} and UNSUPPORTED_CURRENCY error code match the spec exactly; two tests assert both rejection and acceptance.

text: The amount of a single transaction SHALL be greater than zero and SHALL NOT exceed INR 1,00,000.00 (INR-equivalent). Requests above the limit SHALL be rejected with AMOUNT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED.
rationale: MAX_TXN_AMOUNT_INR corrected from 200000 to 100000 (1,00,000 INR). test_pf002_rejects_amount_above_limit asserts 150 000 INR raises AMOUNT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED; test_pf002_accepts_amount_at_limit asserts exactly 1,00,000 INR is accepted. Old test_large_payment_within_limit replaced.

text: Payment creation SHALL be idempotent: a repeated request with the same idempotency key within 24 hours SHALL return the original payment and SHALL NOT create a new charge.
rationale: IDEMPOTENCY_TTL=24h matches spec; dedup logic returns original payment within TTL; test asserts same id and no duplicate charge.

text: Monetary amounts SHALL be stored as integer minor units (paise/cents). Floating-point amounts SHALL be rejected.
rationale: to_minor_units raises PaymentError('INVALID_AMOUNT') when isinstance(amount, float). test_pf004_rejects_float_amount calls to_minor_units(1234.56) and asserts INVALID_AMOUNT is raised.

text: A refund SHALL only be permitted within 30 days of capture. Later requests SHALL be rejected with REFUND_WINDOW_EXPIRED.
rationale: REFUND_WINDOW corrected from timedelta(days=60) to timedelta(days=30). Tests assert immediate refund succeeds, refund after 31 days raises REFUND_WINDOW_EXPIRED, and refund after 45 days (previously allowed by old 60-day window) also raises REFUND_WINDOW_EXPIRED.

text: The cumulative refunded amount SHALL NOT exceed the captured amount. Violations SHALL be rejected with REFUND_EXCEEDS_CAPTURE.
rationale: Guard on refunded_minor + refund_minor > amount_minor raises REFUND_EXCEEDS_CAPTURE; test asserts exact error code after cumulative over-refund.

text: Every payment state change SHALL write an audit record containing payment id, actor, previous state, new state and timestamp.
rationale: AuditRecord captures payment_id, actor, old_state, new_state, timestamp for every transition; test asserts the full sequence including actor name.

text: Full card numbers (PAN) SHALL NEVER be written to application logs. Where a card must be referenced, only the last four digits MAY be shown (PCI-DSS Req. 3.4).
rationale: log.info in create_payment now uses card_number[-4:] (masked as ****XXXX) instead of the full PAN. test_pf008_full_pan_not_logged captures the payflow logger at INFO level and asserts the full 16-digit CARD string is absent and the last-4 digits are present.

text: Calls to the card gateway SHALL be retried at most 3 times with exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s) on HTTP 5xx or timeout. HTTP 4xx responses SHALL NOT be retried.
rationale: BACKOFF_SECONDS=(1,2,4) implements 3-retry exponential backoff; 4xx GatewayError is re-raised immediately (status < 500 check). Four tests: retries exactly 3 times on 5xx; backoff sequence is [1,2,4]; 4xx raises immediately with 1 call; timeout triggers retry.

text: Each merchant SHALL be limited to 20 payment-creation requests per rolling minute. Excess requests SHALL be rejected with RATE_LIMITED.
rationale: MAX_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE=20 and RATE_LIMITED error match spec; test exhausts 20 requests for m1 and asserts rejection, then passes m2 (per-merchant isolation).

text: Payments with an INR-equivalent amount above INR 50,000.00 SHALL be flagged as requiring step-up authentication (2FA) before authorization.
rationale: STEP_UP_THRESHOLD_INR=50000 added; authorize() now accepts step_up_verified param and raises STEP_UP_REQUIRED when amount_inr > 50000 and step_up_verified is False. Three tests: above-threshold without flag raises STEP_UP_REQUIRED; with flag succeeds; at/below threshold needs no flag.

text: Payment status SHALL follow CREATED -> AUTHORIZED -> CAPTURED -> PARTIALLY_REFUNDED/REFUNDED (or FAILED). Any other transition SHALL be rejected with INVALID_TRANSITION.
rationale: ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS enforces the exact state machine from the spec; INVALID_TRANSITION error matches; tests cover both happy path and illegal transition.

text: Currency conversion SHALL use exchange rates no older than 15 minutes; otherwise the request SHALL be rejected with STALE_RATE.
rationale: MAX_RATE_AGE=timedelta(minutes=15) and STALE_RATE error already implemented in fx.py. Three tests: stale rate (16 min) raises STALE_RATE; fresh rate (5 min) converts correctly; rate exactly at 15-min boundary is accepted (exclusive boundary).

text: All timestamps SHALL be stored in UTC using ISO-8601 format.
rationale: utc_now() returns datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() giving UTC ISO-8601; test parses created_at and audit timestamp, verifies zero utcoffset and +00:00 suffix.
